There is something really concerning (and disappointing) going on in the US right now.
A dangerous and preventable situation.
Let me explain.
1/

In early 2022 a new variant of H5N1 bird flu made its way to the US.
It wasn’t subtle.  It quickly swept the country and caused massive bird mortality among all different bird types.
2/

Remember a few years ago when eggs were more expensive than beef?  H5N1 was the reason.  It is extremely pathogenic to chickens.
3/

There were a number of spillovers from H5N1 into various mammals, but most of these were fairly contained.
4/

Then something completely unexpected happened.  In late 2023 or early 2024, H5N1 started showing up in the mammary tissue of dairy cattle.  It was a major outbreak.
5/

It took several months to figure out this was happening, and by then the virus had spread to herds across the country.
6/

Pasteurization kills H5N1, so there haven’t been any human cases from drinking pasteurized milk.  However, it caused a lot of damage and maintained an enormous outbreak in mammals (not where we want it circulating).
7/

The USDA tried to contain the outbreak by preventing the transport of lactating cattle across state lines unless they test negative for H5N1.  It wasn’t enough though.
8/

This should have ended 2 years ago.  It is SUPER easy to screen herds for the virus (bulk milk testing).
Infected cattle clear the virus after a few weeks.  The outbreak could have been stopped (and still can be) if we had the will to enforce strict quarantines.

We don’t.
9/

Here’s the other disappointing part.  This is a phylogenetic tree of the H5N1 lineages since the start.  Notice how all of the sequences from this year cluster together?
10/

If you look at where those sequences came from you see that they are from all over the country.  That means the virus is not contained, it’s continuing to move across the country.
11/

The fear is that with time the virus will adapt to mammalian transmission and start infecting other mammalian species, which is happening already (and we aren’t doing much about it).
12/

Among those species is human.
So far there hasn’t been sustained human-to-human transmission, but if we keep giving the virus  chances, it is just a matter of time.
13/13

hits.draft_en:
The US H5N1 situation in dairy herds is a slow-motion failure, and it was avoidable.

Short version:
- A new bird flu variant landed in early 2022 and killed huge numbers of birds. It's the reason eggs once cost more than beef.
- In late 2023 or early 2024 it jumped into the mammary tissue of dairy cattle. Months passed before anyone caught it, and by then herds nationwide were infected.
- Pasteurized milk has caused no human cases. The danger is a massive outbreak circulating in mammals.

The fix is not complicated. Bulk milk testing screens herds cheaply, infected animals clear the virus within weeks, and strict quarantines would end it. Moving only test-negative lactating cows across state lines did not go far enough.

This year's sequences cluster together and come from all over the country, so the virus is still on the move. Each new mammal infection is another shot at adapting, humans included. No sustained person-to-person spread so far.

I’m seeing a lot of uninformed takes, like this one, about cell simulation feasibility. I wanted to contribute some facts. 

Alphafold works for predicting a subset of static structures (not how a protein structure changes shape under forces) on 1) well-ordered regions (not intrinsically disordered regions or long flexible loops) and 2) on proteins with plenty of evolutionary relatives (no orphan proteins). 

Alphafold solved this subset of static structure prediction with a dataset that took 50 years (PDB; 1971 to ~2020) to collect. It did not solve protein dynamics or how proteins fold into their shapes. Those remain unsolved. 

Cell simulation is vastly more complex and data hungry than any of this. Exact cell simulation means solving quantum equations for every atom and is totally intractable.  But all approximations rely on - and are bottlenecked by - data, not compute.

So the extrapolation from “alphafold worked” to “therefore cell simulation is feasible” assumes far too much.

hits.text:
In 1986 a guy got kicked out of every casino in Vegas for counting cards. So he flew to Hong Kong with $180,000 and started betting on horses instead.

He walked away with almost $900 million.

It was Bill Benter.

He realized horse racing was just another counting problem  same math, more moving parts.

He and a partner built a computer model that estimated the true odds of each horse. If his numbers showed an edge, he bet. If not, he skipped it.

That’s the whole trick:

Expected value.

EV = p · b − (1 − p)

Only bet when the probability of winning × the potential payout is greater than the chance of losing.

What’s even crazier is that Benter once gave a 45-minute lecture explaining the math behind his system.

That recording was never supposed to become public.

And almost nobody knows it exists.

This is the lecture that professional bettors and hedge fund analysts studied.

The answer is in this video.

NIH scientist proposed engineering coronavirus to be more infectious weeks before pandemic, emails show | Willow Tohi & Views, Natural News

- NIH virologist Vincent Munster emailed his postdoc on Oct. 6, 2019, proposing to engineer a furin cleavage site into a coronavirus spike protein to "enhance infectivity."

- The proposed modification matches the central genetic feature cited by lab-leak proponents as evidence SARS-CoV-2 did not arise naturally.

- Munster's lab also solicited and received unpublished bat coronavirus spike sequences from the U.S.-funded PREDICT program months before the pandemic.

- The furin site Munster suggested differs from the one found in SARS-CoV-2, which has a "suboptimal" motif researchers say would be illogical for an engineered virus.

- Munster was indicted in 2026 for smuggling mpox virus samples into the U.S. without proper documentation.

The proposal: Engineering a furin cleavage site

One Sunday morning in October 2019, Vincent Munster, chief of the virus ecology unit at the National Institutes of Health's Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, emailed a postdoctoral scientist in his lab with an idea. Eleven weeks before a coronavirus carrying a similar feature emerged in Wuhan, China, Munster proposed engineering a furin cleavage site into a SARS-like spike protein to make it more infectious.

The email exchange — obtained by U.S. Right to Know through a Freedom of Information Act request and never before made public — shows Munster suggesting his postdoc Michael Letko "make S with a more broader cleavage signature (like furin-like) to enhance infectivity." In virology parlance, "S" refers to the coronavirus spike protein that allows the virus to latch onto cells. Munster even provided the genetic motif: "R-X-[K/R]-R."

Scientific context behind the furin site

The furin cleavage site found in SARS-CoV-2 remains the only known such feature among all SARS-related coronaviruses found in nature, making it the single genetic characteristic most frequently cited by proponents of a laboratory origin for the pandemic.

Munster's suggestion followed his reading of a preprint from virologists Vineet Menachery and Ralph Baric showing that the protease trypsin could unlock entry for coronaviruses that otherwise would not infect human cells. Letko had forwarded the paper two days earlier, noting "Seems like more groups will be converging on this idea soon."

However, the furin cleavage site Munster proposed differs from the one found in SARS-CoV-2. The pandemic virus carries a "suboptimal" RRAR motif, while Munster suggested the textbook canonical form R-X-K/R-R. This discrepancy, the records show, aligns with arguments from scientists who contend an engineered virus would have used the optimal sequence.

Unpublished sequences: A second thread

Beyond the furin site proposal, the records reveal Munster's lab actively solicited unpublished bat coronavirus spike sequences from the U.S.-funded PREDICT consortium, whose lead partner EcoHealth Alliance had long-standing collaborations with the Wuhan Institute of Virology.

In March 2019, Munster emailed EcoHealth President Peter Daszak and Columbia University virologist Simon Anthony seeking "additional, unpublished lineage B beta coronavirus sequences." The request aimed to test which bat coronaviruses could infect human cells using Letko's newly developed "rapid and scalable platform."

Within two months, Anthony shared sequences from a Malaysian bat virus and one from Uganda and Rwanda. Neither was closely related enough to SARS-CoV-2 to have given rise to it. But the exchange demonstrated that U.S. government scientists were using unpublished viral sequences precisely because they were unpublished — contradicting a 2021 Cell review that called such scenarios implausible.

Historical parallels to DEFUSE proposal

The Munster email is the second known instance of scientists proposing to insert a furin cleavage site into a SARS-like spike within two years of COVID-19's emergence. In 2018, EcoHealth Alliance, Baric's lab and Wuhan Institute of Virology researchers had proposed similar modifications to the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency under a program called DEFUSE. That proposal was denied over gain-of-function research concerns.

Sen. Rand Paul has alleged that Munster was listed as a partner in the DEFUSE proposal presented at a January 2018 DARPA event, though Munster was removed from the final submission. The newly released records show no direct link between Munster and DEFUSE.

What happened next

The records show no evidence that Letko followed through on Munster's suggestion to engineer a furin cleavage site. When Chinese scientists posted the novel coronavirus sequence on Jan. 10, 2020, Munster's lab pivoted to testing the actual pandemic virus. Their paper, published in Nature within 12 days, confirmed that SARS-CoV-2 used the ACE2 receptor for cell entry.

The paper's second figure — titled "Trypsin enhances lineage B entry in various cell lines" — used trypsin rather than the furin Munster had proposed. Neither of the PREDICT sequences appeared in the final publication.

Munster did not respond to requests for comment. He was indicted earlier this year for bringing mpox specimens into the U.S. without proper documentation and making false statements to law enforcement, charges to which he has pleaded not guilty.

Implications for origins debate

The newly disclosed emails do not prove SARS-CoV-2 was engineered in a laboratory. Nothing links Munster's research to the pandemic virus, and the furin site he proposed differs from the one found in nature. But the records establish that weeks before COVID-19 emerged, a senior NIH virologist proposed in writing to build the very feature that has become the central argument for a laboratory origin.

As molecular biologist Alina Chan, who reviewed the records, noted: "What this shows is that different groups of virologists were converging on the idea of inserting cleavage sites in the spikes of potentially dangerous coronaviruses. Assuming a lab origin of COVID-19, if a lab in Wuhan hadn't caused the pandemic, it's plausible that a lab in the U.S. would've eventually followed the same path."

The records also raise questions about transparency. The NIH press office declined to answer why the agency had not previously disclosed that its scientists proposed engineering a furin site, or that they solicited and obtained unpublished SARS-like coronavirus sequences, before the pandemic began.

copying context, explaining tasks, and making sure nothing gets lost.

no more manual copy-pasting between agents.

One lesson from reviewing biomarkers in young people with Long COVID: a statistically different blood marker is not the same as a diagnostic test. In our review, 9 studies reported 41 biomarker findings. Promising biology, but no validated test for clinical use.  

I want biomarkers that help us understand mechanisms and, eventually, guide care. But normal routine tests should never be used to dismiss symptoms.

For patients and families: what would make the biggest difference now—better tests, better care pathways, or both?

الأول يتغير بتغير مصالحه، والثاني تكشفه المواقف مهما تغيرت الظروف.

برأيكم، هل المواقف تكشف حقيقة

أحيانًا يقول الأب لابنه: «أبيك تكون صريح معي، ولا تخاف تقول اللي في خاطرك». لكن أول ما يسمع منه رأيًا يخالف رأيه، يتضايق ويعتبره قليل احترام أو ما يعرف مصلحته.

المفارقة أن بعض الأهل يريدون

posts.name: Hussain Alharthi
posts.text:
المخدرات ليست مجرد مواد ضارة، بل آفة قد تدمّر عقل الإنسان وصحته وأسرته ومستقبله. وقد تؤدي إلى الإدمان واضطرابات نفسية وسلوكية خطيرة، ومضاعفات صحية قد تصل إلى الوفاة. والأخطر أن المروّج لا يبيع مواد سامة فحسب، بل قد يسرق مستقبل إنسان ويحوّل معاناة أسرة كاملة إلى مأساة.
لكن مواجهة هذه الآفة لا تبدأ عند القبض على المروّج، بل قبل ذلك بكثير. تبدأ من أسرة تلاحظ التغيّر في سلوك أبنائها وتحتويهم بالحوار والاهتمام، بدل أن تتركهم فريسة للفراغ أو رفاق السوء. وتبدأ من مدرسة لا تكتفي بالتعليم، بل تبني الوعي، وتعلّم الطلبة كيف يرفضون ضغط الأقران، وتلاحظ التغيّرات السلوكية والنفسية وتتدخل مبكرًا.
وهنا يأتي دور الأب والأم، وهو دور لا يمكن تعويضه مهما توفرت للأبناء من وسائل الراحة والرفاهية. فانشغال الأب بعمله، وانشغال الأم بمسؤولياتها، أو انغراقهما في خلافاتهما ومشكلاتهما الزوجية، قد يجعل الأبناء يعيشون في البيت نفسه مع والديهم، لكنهم يفتقدون القرب الحقيقي منهما. قد يحصل الابن على كل ما يحتاجه ماديًا، لكنه يظل محتاجًا إلى أب يجلس معه ويسأله عن يومه، وأم تستمع إليه وتفهم ما يقلقه، وشخص يشعر أمامه بالأمان حين يخطئ أو يتعثر أو يواجه مشكلة لا يعرف كيف يتعامل معها.
الأبناء لا يحتاجون إلى من يوفّر لهم احتياجاتهم فقط، بل يحتاجون إلى من يسمعهم دون أن يقاطعهم، ويحتوي همومهم دون أن يسخر منها، ويمنحهم الوقت الكافي للحديث عن تفاصيل حياتهم اليومية، مهما بدت صغيرة في نظر الكبار. فالمشكلة التي يراها الأب بسيطة قد تكون في نظر ابنه أزمة كبيرة، والكلمة التي يحتاج إلى سماعها في لحظة ضيق قد تحميه من قرار يندم عليه سنوات.
وحين يغيب هذا الاحتواء، لا تختفي حاجة الابن إلى الحديث والمشاركة، بل يبدأ بالبحث عمن يمنحه الشعور بأنه مفهوم ومسموع. قد يجد ذلك لدى رفقاء السوء، أو لدى أشخاص يتعرف إليهم عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، فيبدأ الأمر بفضفضة أو صداقة أو نصيحة ظاهرها الاهتمام، ثم يستغل أحدهم ضعفه أو وحدته أو مشكلاته النفسية ليجرّه تدريجيًا إلى التعاطي أو سلوكيات مدمرة أخرى. وهنا تكمن الخطورة؛ فليس كل من يستمع إلى أبنائنا يريد مصلحتهم، وليس كل من يظهر التعاطف معهم صادقًا في نواياه.
ولا يعني ذلك أن انشغال الوالدين أو خلافاتهما يؤدي حتمًا إلى الإدمان، فالأسباب متعددة، لكن غياب الحوار والاحتواء قد يترك فراغًا عاطفيًا يستغله من يبحث عن استدراج الأبناء. لذلك فإن تخصيص وقت يومي للجلوس مع الأبناء، والاستماع إلى مشكلاتهم دون إصدار أحكام متسرعة، ومتابعة صداقاتهم وعلاقاتهم الإلكترونية بحكمة، أمور أساسية في حمايتهم. والأهم أن يشعر الابن بأنه يستطيع العودة إلى والديه والاعتراف بمشكلته قبل أن تتفاقم، دون خوف من الإهانة أو الإقصاء أو العقاب الذي يمنعه من طلب المساعدة.
كما أن العلاقة بين الأب والأم تنعكس على الأبناء؛ فالبيت الذي تسوده الخلافات المستمرة قد يدفع بعضهم إلى الانعزال أو البحث عن الانتماء والاهتمام خارج الأسرة. ولهذا فإن حماية الأبناء تبدأ أيضًا من حرص الوالدين على إدارة خلافاتهما بعيدًا عنهم، وعدم جعلهم طرفًا في النزاعات، وإشعارهم بأنهم محبوبون وآمنون مهما كانت الظروف.
وللمجتمع دور لا يقل أهمية؛ فالتطبيع مع المخدرات، والتستر على المروّجين، والسخرية من المدمن بدل مساعدته، كلها أمور تزيد المشكلة تعقيدًا. المطلوب بيئة تحمي الشباب، وتمنحهم بدائل صحية، وتفتح أمامهم أبواب الرياضة والعمل والأنشطة المفيدة، وتشجع الإبلاغ عن الترويج دون تردد
أما الدولة، فمسؤوليتها حاسمة في ضرب شبكات التهريب والترويج، وتجفيف مصادر التمويل، وتطبيق القانون بحزم، ومراقبة قنوات التوزيع، وتوفير مراكز علاج وتأهيل متخصصة يسهل الوصول إليها. فالمروّج الذي يستهدف عقول الشباب ومستقبلهم يجب أن يُحاسب وفق القانون، أما المتعاطي فيحتاج إلى الحماية من استمرار الإدمان، والعلاج، وإعادة التأهيل، حتى لا يفقد فرصته في استعادة حياته.
وهنا يجب أن نفهم أن الإدمان ليس قضية أمنية فقط، ولا صحية فقط، بل قضية أسرية وتعليمية ونفسية وأخلاقية وأمنية متكاملة. العقوبة وحدها لا تمنع كل الحالات، والتوعية وحدها لا تكفي إذا بقيت المخدرات متاحة، والعلاج لا ينجح دائمًا إذا عاد الإنسان إلى البيئة نفسها التي دفعته إلى التعاطي.
المطلوب أن تتكامل الأدوار: أسرة تحتضن، ومدرسة تحصّن، ومجتمع لا يتستر، ودولة تحمي وتحاسب وتعالج. والأهم ألا ننتظر حتى يتحول الابن إلى حالة إدمان أو مأساة إنسانية قبل أن ننتبه إليه.
حماية الشباب من المخدرات ليست مسؤولية جهة واحدة، بل مسؤولية الجميع. فكل شاب ننقذه اليوم هو إنسان نحمي مستقبله، وأسرة نحفظ استقرارها، ومجتمع نحمي أمنه. وأخطر ما يمكن أن نفعله هو أن نرى الخطر يقترب من أبنائنا ثم نكتشف متأخرين أننا تركناهم وحدهم.

وهنا يجب أن نفهم أن الإدمان ليس قضية أمنية فقط، ولا صحية فقط، بل قضية أسرية وتعليمية ونفسية وأخلاقية وأمنية متكاملة. العقوبة وحدها لا تمنع كل الحالات، والتوعية وحدها لا تكفي إذا بقيت المخدرات متاحة، والعلاج لا ينجح دائمًا إذا عاد الإنسان إلى البيئة نفسها التي دفعته إلى التعاطي.

posts.text:
كامل حسين عميل صهيوني معروف نشط في منطقة الحولة وجنوب لبنان في شراء الاراضي لليهود. هناك العديد من التقارير الامنية الفرنسية التي تتحدث عن نشاطاته تلك. كان اسمه على لائحة التصفية الجسدية التي وضعها الثوار الفلسطينيون. ومن سخريات القدر وفساد السلطة اللبنانية انه اعطي الجنسية اللبنانية وسمح له بالاقامة في لبنان وكان يتمتع بحماية من كبار السياسيين. وكان في ربيع عام  1949 يقضي فصل الصيف في منطقة الحاصباني. حاولت الاستخبارات السورية في 10 أيار 1949 اختطافه إلى دمشق، وأرسلت كميناً لهذه الغاية إلى جسر الحاصباني. ولمّا رفض الحسين الصعود إلى السيارة العسكرية التي كانت بإمرة النقيب أكرم طبارة، وقاوم مختطفيه، بادر الراعي متعب شتيوي، وهو من المجموعة الخاطفة، إلى إطلاق النار، فقُتل كامل الحسين ومرافقه عوض يوسف سعيد وسائق سيارته أحمد الحلبي. ودفن القتيل في مقبرة بلدة الخيام اللبنانية الجنوبية. وادى الامر الى ازمة بين لبنان وسوريا،واعتبر لبنان ان سيادتة انتهكت. التالي نموذج عن نشاطاته في تقرير امني فرنسي:
"المفوضية العامة للجمهورية الفرنسية في المشرق.
أمن الجيوش، سري. الرقم 1419
نشرة معلومات.
بتاريخ 11/4/1945.
صيدا.
(مرجعيون).
السيد كامل حسين.
أثناء الأسبوع المنصرم، زار كامل حسين عدّة مرّات مرجعيون ومنطقتها. ولدى مروره، كان يتواصل مع السيد قازان والكابتن توماس من البعثة الأمنية البريطانية.
في العاشر من نيسان، كان ينوي أن يدعو إلى العشاء عدّة ضبّاطٍ بريطانيين، لكنّ سفر شخصيةٍ رفيعةٍ من صفد، كان قد ذهب لتوديعها، منعه من ذلك.
هدف تلك الزيارات المتقاربة إلى قضاء مرجعيون هو شراء مساحاتٍ واسعةً من الأراضي التي تعود ملكيتها إلى السيد جورج فرحات، لحساب شركةٍ يهودية، تقع في الزاوية (فلسطين). ومن المعتقد أنّ عمولته تبلغ ليرتين فلسطينيتين ونصف الليرة للدونم الواحد. تمّ تقديم مبلغٍ قدره 92 ألف ليرة فلسطينية لجورج فرحات. وعلى الرغم من رغبته في الاحتفاظ بأراضيه، إلاّ أنّه وجد نفسه مرغماً على بيعها نظراً لأنّ الحكومة الفلسطينية كانت تحجز كلّ عامٍ على نتاج محاصيله.
هنالك استياءٌ عميقٌ تجاه السيد كامل حسين بين عرب القضاء الذين يمتلكون أراضي في فلسطين. فهم يدركون بأنّهم سيكونون مرغمين على التفاوض ذات يوم مع هذا العميل الصهيوني".

posts.text:
Don’t forget that the whole IPv4 internet is ~4 billion addresses and every single one can be probed in under an hour from one machine. 

This story mixes a couple of headlines: 
1. 1000s of people’s GPU monitoring dashboards were found sitting on the public internet with no authentication. Anyone can read them. 
2. The guys who found the exposed dashboards noticed that some were from clusters on Chinese IPs with the export-banned B300 GPUs. 
3. These NVIDIA dashboards have a vulnerability dating back months that allows an attacker to DoS them, crashing that cluster’s GPU monitoring.

(1) is the bigger issue to me - maybe the result of too much vibe coding. The vulnerability (CVE in DCGM Exporter) should be fixed but doesn’t strike me as very concerning since these dashboard endpoints shouldn’t be on the public internet to begin with and only relate to monitoring.

posts.text:
In 1986 a guy got kicked out of every casino in Vegas for counting cards. So he flew to Hong Kong with $180,000 and started betting on horses instead.

He walked away with almost $900 million.

It was Bill Benter.

He realized horse racing was just another counting problem  same math, more moving parts.

He and a partner built a computer model that estimated the true odds of each horse. If his numbers showed an edge, he bet. If not, he skipped it.

That’s the whole trick:

Expected value.

EV = p · b − (1 − p)

Only bet when the probability of winning × the potential payout is greater than the chance of losing.

What’s even crazier is that Benter once gave a 45-minute lecture explaining the math behind his system.

That recording was never supposed to become public.

And almost nobody knows it exists.

This is the lecture that professional bettors and hedge fund analysts studied.

The answer is in this video.

🇧🇷 HOW did Lula manage to gain 10M votes between rounds in Brazil's presidential election, compared with just 4M for Flávio Bolsonaro?

In the first round, ~9.5M votes went to other candidates, while changes in turnout, blank ballots, and invalid votes added another ~5M to the calculation.

That leaves a pool of ~14M votes.

Flávio gained 4M, rising from 56M to ~60M.

Lula gained 10M, jumping from 54M to 64.1M.

That works out to 71% of the net gains for Lula and just 29% for Flávio.

What makes this particularly striking is the claim that ~10M of those 14M votes came from voters who had backed eliminated candidates with more right-wing political platforms.

So how did Lula end up gaining so much more ground in just 3 weeks?

The figures don't prove wrongdoing or show exactly how individuals voted, but the dramatic shift has raised serious questions about the results.

To say nothing of the unprecedented 2-hr extension of voting, signed off by Lula's own fmr. defense attorney...

Something stinks...

Sources: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, G1, @BolsonaroSP / Writers: Mhedi, Michael

Russia's FSB security service arrested two men accused of preparing the attacks under instructions from Ukraine's SBU intelligence agency.

According to the FSB, the suspects collected explosive-laden first-person-view (FPV) drones from two Russian regions before transporting them to the Moscow area.

The drones were reportedly configured locally and intended to be controlled remotely by operators in Ukraine.

Russian authorities claim one suspect was recruited by an SBU officer and promised money to carry out the operation, before enlisting an acquaintance.

The alleged plot highlights a potentially serious vulnerability for Moscow: drones launched close to strategic defenses, bypassing the long-distance approach that Russian air defenses are designed to intercept.

Ukraine has not commented on the allegations, which remain independently unverified.
